title: jobValidation
responsibility: Validate durable job identity and paired completion timing, and construct stable source-job-attempt database keys.

inputs.name: jobRecord.input
inputs.description: Lifecycle record validated before persistence: nonempty identity, positive attempt and finite nonnegative timestamps. Completed records require outcome and matching duration.

inputs.name: jobKey.key
inputs.description: Source, job ID and attempt tuple serialized as a compact JSON array to avoid collisions across runs or models.

outputs.name: jobRecord
outputs.description: Validated record stripped to the stored lifecycle schema; inconsistent completion timing is rejected.

outputs.name: jobKey
outputs.description: Compact JSON tuple of source, job ID and attempt, preserving each identity field exactly.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Rejects invalid lifecycle timing, identity or scheduling flags before the operation can record or estimate work.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: Rejects malformed identity, attempt, timestamp or outcome fields before a database write.
